description: DOT/FMCSA Compliance MCP Server. An MCP server that makes DOT/FMCSA trucking regulations queryable by AI agents. Covers 49 CFR Parts 350-399 (FMCSA), Hazardous Materials (49 CFR 100-185), Hours of Service, and CSA BASIC categories.
